about: Moncton Parish is a civil parish in Westmorland County, New Brunswick, covering rural territory around—but not including—the City of Moncton. Countryside, villages, and suburban-edge communities share the parish’s land outside the separate city. About 10,000 people live in Moncton Parish.
seoSummary: Westmorland County civil parish around Moncton—rural and edge communities, not the City of Moncton.
